general_information.Description: The course is designed to provide students with a strong foundation in marketing based on five key activities: (1) identifying customer needs, (2) providing customers with the right products or service to meet their needs, (3) assuring availability to customers through the right distribution channels, (4) using promotional activities in ways that motivate purchase as effectively as possible, (5) setting an appropriate price that maximizes firm profitability while maintaining customer satisfaction. The Principle of Marketing course (Philip Kotler) integrates AI tools as supportive instruments for idea generation, document organization, and the practical application of marketing concepts. Students will employ AI for brainstorming, content structuring, creation of marketing materials, and basic analytics, while retaining full responsibility for ensuring originality, critical evaluation, and refinement of their work. The course also equips students to assess the strengths and limitations of AI-generated outputs and to identify ethical risks such as plagiarism and bias. Tools Utilized: - lmarena AI: For generating marketing-related data and insights. - Statista: For accessing statistical data and market research. - ChatGPT: For idea generation, structuring documents, and simulating real-life marketing scenarios. - Canva: For creating visual marketing materials like infographics, templates, and videos. The assessment methods have been reformed to more accurately reflect students’ actual competencies. Learners are evaluated through oral examinations, presentations, group debates, and the assessment of submitted products, as well as through their selection of prompts, which demonstrate their thinking process, revisions, and interactions with AI feedback.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

Identify wants and environmental factors that shape marketing activities for certain target markets
Demonstrate knowledge of the individual components of a marketing mix
Demonstrate knowledge of key business communication strategies within the marketing field

constructive_questions.Details: “Many people think of marketing as selling & advertising”. What is your opinion on this statement? Let's analyze the difference between marketing and selling?
Marketing is creating and capturing customer value. Let's analyze the marketing process for creating and capturing customer value in a business company
Discuss the concept of customer relationship management. Why is it essential that a business incorporates this in its operations?
Which factors belong to the macro environment, what is the purpose of the company to analyze these factors? Give examples to demonstrate?
Explain how changes in the demographic and economic environments in Vietnam affect marketing decisions for a particular business?
Discuss how companies can react to the marketing environment
Analyze the sequence of work that needs to be done to implement a marketing research project for a business company
Let's analyze the difference between secondary data and primary data? Give examples for each type?

Please suggest a sampling method to have a sample size of 100 samples from a total of 500 students (in which: 200 Business Administration students, 150 Languages students and 150 IT students). It is required that each member have an equal chance of being selected and that the sample contains enough students from the 3 majors mentioned.
What are the major factors that influence your buying behavior when you: 1. buy a car and 2. buy clothes online?
How is your buying decision behavior different when you buy a motorbike and when you buy a book at the bookstore?
What are the stages in the buyer decision process you usually go through when you buy something? Are the stages the same for all buying decisions?
Why should innovating firm research the characteristics of innovators and early adopters in their product categories and direct marketing efforts toward them?
Why are the risks much higher in Boeing's business of selling airplanes to airlines?
Company X is considering to hire an event organizing agency to organize their end-of-year party. Who are the participants in this business decision process?
What are some major factors that influence Company X in the decision to buy raw materials for their manufacturing activities?

What are some stages that Company X should go through to come to the decision of buying office supplies for the company? Are those stages different if Company X is looking to buy some raw materials for manufacturing?
Explain some ways Samsung can segment their smartphone market. Give examples.
What are the levels of market targeting? Which level of marketing targeting Samsung chooses for their smartphone business?
In your opinion, what is Samsung's positioning in the smartphone market? How can positioning bring about competitive advantages for the company?

What are the possible value propositions on which a company might position its products? If you are a new company in Vietnam trying to compete in the smartphone market, what would be your value position?
What are some types of consumer products? How are marketing considerations different for these types of consumer products?
If you are a new company in the Vietnamese marketing selling packaged food, what are the decisions that you will have to make regarding your product?
What are the differences between product mix width, length, consistency, and depth?
How are services different from products? How is marketing for services different from marketing for products?

If you are a new company in Vietnam with a business in providing private, customized tours around Vietnam, what would the major brand strategy decisions that you would make in order to build your brand?
How important is pricing to the firm's performance?

An Armani black T-shirt costs $275, whereas a similar one from Gap or H&M costs $14.9 and $7.9 respectivly. Customers who purchase Armani T-shirt are paying for a T-shrit made of 70 percent nylon, 25 percent polyester, and 5 percent elastane, whereas the Gap and H&M shrits are made mainly of cotton. True, the Armani T is a bit more stylishly cut than the other two and sports a “Made in Italy” label, but how does it command a $275.00 price tag? How can Armani set such high price that customers are willing to pay? What are the differences among the pricing approaches used by Armani, and H&M and Gap?
Why is it difficult for firms to employ value-based pricing?
Why is copst-plus pricing still being employed by several companies despite of its limitations?
Why does a company need to consider competitor's prices when setting price?

In fall 2013, Apple introduced iPhone 5c which is lower-priced iPhone model. iPhone 5c featured a plastic case and was available in various colors; the price was about $100 lower than the new iPhone 5s. The iphone 5c targeted to consumers in the emerging markets who could not afford a higher-priced models (5, 5s). But in fact, the price of 5c is much higher than several alternatives in the market. What factors did impact the pricing decision of Apple on the 5c?

A high-tech company is about to introduce a new portable mixed reality device to individual market. The pricing manager is considering between two new product pricing strategy and he ask for your advice. What should you tell him?
How can companies maximise their profits on the total product mix by pricing?
How can companies adjust their pricing strategies for various customer differences and changing situation? Find real-life examples to illustrate each strategy.
When and how should a company change its price?
Imaging that your direct competior is running program that decreases its product prices. How should a company response to the price change by a competitor?
Why do companies use marketing channels? What are the functions these channels perform?
How do channel members interact and organize to perform the work of the channel?
How does the advanced of technology change the channel organization?
Why is new IMC important in the current market?
In the Vietnam market, there are too many advertising popping up on social media platform. How do you evaluate this phenomenon?, and how does it affect consumers?
If this phenomenon (social media advertising) was continuing, how do you see the future of IMC via social media?
Investigate the current advertising industry in Vietnam and compare it to the Korean commercial industry, then offers recommendations for Vietnamese businesses in doing advertising.
Why public relation is one of the most powerful tools to help the firm in terms of doing IMC as well as standing out from the competition? Find evidence to support your point of view.
Why is buzz marketing so powerful?
How do sale person build and maintain profitable relationship with customers? Give examples for your case.
How can personality affect on the handling objection? Give examples to demonstrate your point of view.
List the occations when business can do promotion and explain why cannot promtion be usually applied?
